Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000679": As of 2025-09-23, Lena has the Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000673" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-23, anything Boreal-related should be paged to Lena, not Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000011": As of 2025-01-07, the Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000442": On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the billing API handover doc for Lena Fischer.  (about: Lena, billing API, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000409": Lena is the release captain for Q1 2026.  (about: Lena)
- memory_id "1000390": On 2025-05-15, Oskar walked Lena through the webhook dispatcher runbook as part of the handover.  (about: Lena, webhook dispatcher, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000768": On 2025-11-03, the Boreal team reported that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.  (about: Boreal team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000394": As of 2025-05-15, the webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000488": As of 2025-06-11, the notifier went to the Dune team, which the Boreal team owned until 2025-06-11; the Cinder team never owned the notifier.  (about: Boreal team, Cinder, Dune team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000240": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000055": The Boreal team looks after the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000690": The nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs, which prompted the reporting service to switch from the ledger service to the bus.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000686" [decision]: As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service switched from the ledger service to the bus as its source.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000228": On 2025-02-21, the Boreal team noticed the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000764" [decision]: As of 2025-11-03, the Boreal team decided that the webhook dispatcher will sign payloads with rotating keys because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000367": On 2025-05-07, the Boreal team noticed the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000742": As of 2025-10-15, Farah has the Dune pager this cycle, taking over from Tomasz.  (about: Tomasz, Farah, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000757": As of 2025-10-24, Diego has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki Tanaka.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder)
- memory_id "1000564" [constraint]: As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman should be paged for anything this cycle.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman)
- memory_id "1000551": As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team, taking over from Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
